title: A glyph set in a fallback font loses its run's bold weight
body: The heading "stage 3: buckets → partitions → groups" in the sufr pipeline figure in `sufr-figures` is set in `sans-bold`. That face has no `→`, so acre sets the arrows from a fallback font. They come out thinner and smaller than the bold words around them. The fallback order from acre-60d212 starts with `sans`, so the arrows probably come from the regular face. That has not been checked in the code.
